sourceRef.section: Starting Spell Attacks, Mage: Base Spells, Mage: Subclass Spells, Priest: Base Spells, Priest: Subclass Spells, Elemental Attributes and Assault Timing, Artificer Formulas Are Not Starting Spell Attacks

description: The authoritative PC profiles for Spell Attacks granted by a Base Class or Subclass. These identical profiles are repeated in the Classes chapter (05_classes.md) for ease of character creation, and are also captured in pc/classes/mage.json and pc/classes/priest.json. The A value is the final starting number of Attack dice for a PC before specific Talent, Command, or equipment modifications. Starting spells are included in the PC's base battlefield value unless expressly identified as optional with a separate Point cost. Spell Attacks do not occupy the four optional prepared Command slots.

spells.name: Force Bolt
spells.effect: On Surge, push the target 1" away from the caster, respecting legal placement.

elementalist.note: Choose one subclass spell at creation. Fireball follows Blast; Spark gains Instant only on Surge; Ice Shard applies Slow 2 on Surge.

necromancer.note: Life Drain Heals 1 Damage to the caster if it deals Damage, once per Attack.

illusionist.note: Mind Spike worsens the target's next Hit target by one step, if the Attack occurs this Round. Psychic Blade may be acquired separately and is used during the Combat Phase.

spells.name: Sacred Brand
spells.effect: If the initial post-reroll Hit dice show a Surge, the current Attack gains Accurate 1 and may immediately reroll one natural 1 that has not already been rerolled. This is an exception to the usual order because its Accurate bonus is granted by the Surge itself. Apply any resulting Critical conversions afterward.

cleric.note: Anti-Undead 1 adds one Attack die against Undead.

druid.note: On Surge, applies Slow 2 to the target's next Movement activation.

oracle.note: On Surge, enemies cannot react to that Attack, as for Instant.

balanceNote: These already are complete PC Attack profiles. Only add dice from explicit Talents, Commands, Keywords, or equipment effects. Their provisional Attack counts and the relative strength of low-volume spells still require playtesting.

elementalAttributesAndAssaultTiming.description: The extra Fire, Frost, Lightning, Radiant and Nature descriptors refer to the shared Attack Types and Elemental Attributes rules (10_keywords.md#attack-types-and-elemental-attributes); they do not change Saves on their own. A Fire spell suppresses an applicable creature's regeneration only if unsaved Damage is actually inflicted. Casting a ranged Spell Attack is the Unit's one ordinary Assault action, rather than a free Attack accompanying an Assault Move. Eligible Assault Commands cost CP separately.

artificerFormulasNote: Artificer Subclasses receive Formulas, not the Mage/Priest starting Spell Attacks listed here. Formulas are CP-powered Commands found in Artificer Formulas (18_artificer_formulas.md). Their printed Formula Attack profiles, when applicable, are also repeated in the Artificer Class (05_classes.md#artificer) for ease of selection. See pc/classes/artificer.json for the already-converted Artificer Formulas.
